weapon.reference: blaster.ref in Refs (copy of makeBlaster() at 0.47 scale, bone-parented to weapon_socket, not exported); the game attaches its own weapon at runtime

rightHandFix.problem: right wrist folded ~115 deg: weapon_socket was oriented for a hand hanging in the A-pose, so pointing the gun forward forced the wrist down
fix: weapon_socket re-oriented to a natural pistol grip: hand in line with the forearm, 20 deg down, palm toward the gun; socket at the fist centre (45% along hand.R, 3 cm to the palm)
left hand given a full frame (palm on the front grip) instead of a direction only
hold search rejects wrists bent > 40 deg; jump uses one searched hold per key
bug fixed: PoseBone.matrix leaked scale; search now attaches its weapon first
rightHandFix.result: all clips x all weapons, every frame: wrists <= 39 deg, left-hand gap <= 1.9 cm; blaster/repeater/web never enter the body; scatter grazes (2-9 face pairs) in slide, aim and crouch clips
